scenes.sense: A mouth repeatedly opening and closing
scenes.description: A goldfish at the water surface repeatedly opening and closing its round mouth, seen close-up from the side. Small subtle motion arcs emphasize the mouth movement; no bubbles.
A child eagerly opens their mouth for another small spoonful of curry and rice.
A hand holds a shoe whose loose toe sole gapes open, with small arrows indicating up-and-down flapping.
